notes.title: Announce Trailer & Steam Page Now Live
notes.content:
Hello, comrades!


We’re Rodrigo & Eduardo from Deep Green Games, and after months of enduring BOT.VINNIK’s relentless sarcasm and zero patience, we’re proud to announce: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam!



The game is still in training—but very soon, a free demo will be available. You’ll get to explore the academy, tackle a few clever puzzles, and experience our grumpy coach's unique teaching style firsthand.



Your feedback is vital (before BOT.VINNIK declares humanity a lost cause). Feel free to share your thoughts anytime!



Also: have you seen our Reveal Trailer yet? BOT.VINNIK insists it qualifies for a Grandmaster title. Watch it below—and if it makes you chuckle or nod in respect, don’t forget to Wishlist the game!

BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy announce trailer



Thanks for the support—and for putting up with our electronic mentor.



See you at the Academy! 

Rodrigo & Eduardo Deep Green Games
